description:
Owner follow-up to pre-tractable-worktrees-still-register-todo-db-20261112 (done 2026-11-14), which removed the 28 clean worktrees and kept the rest. 14 BenchBox.wt-* worktrees still register todo-db: 13 hold local work (uncommitted changes, or commits not on origin) and one, polars-probe, is clean but git-locked with the reason "polars version probe measurement environment; do not remove". None has a PR. Their tracker does not work as-is: worktrees pinned to todo-db 0.9.1-0.13.0 get E_SCHEMA from the schema-4 store, and the bare todo-db CLI their skill copy names is gone. The finished item's context lists each one with branch, dirty and unpushed counts and pinned version.

Decision gate (owner, per worktree): keep as is (record why), resume (merge origin/develop so it runs tractable 1.1.1; then push or open a PR), or retire (push or deliberately abandon the local commits, then remove the worktree).

Guardrails:
- Nothing is removed, pushed, reset or unlocked without the owner's per-worktree decision recorded here.
- Removal only after the tree is clean and its commits are on origin, or after the owner records that the commits are abandoned.
- Never patch .mcp.json in place; never force-push.
